title: Code Style & Formatting Standards
description: Enforce uniform naming conventions, module structure, explicit typing, and idiom standards across languages.

title: Code Deduplication & Complexity Control
description: Identify repeated logic, overly complex branching, deeply nested control flow, and redundant abstractions.

title: Readability & Structural Refactoring
description: Enhance code legibility, decomposition of monolithic routines, and maintainable function signatures.

title: Defensive Error Handling & Propagation
description: Mandate explicit error checks, prevent swallowed exceptions, and maintain meaningful error context propagation.

title: Telemetry, Tracing & Structured Logging
description: Standardize structured contextual logging, correlation IDs, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and audit readiness.

title: UI Resilience & Lifecycle Management
description: Eliminate layout thrashing, unhandled UI state exceptions, component memory leaks, and broken lifecycle unmounts.

title: REST & RPC API Contract Compliance
description: Validate HTTP status semantics, payload consistency, idempotent endpoints, and backward-compatible route behaviors.

title: Architectural Boundaries & Separation of Concerns
description: Enforce clean architecture layering, dependency inversion, loose coupling, and package isolation.

title: Defensive Security & Attack Surface Reduction
description: Prevent injection vectors, sanitize untrusted inputs, enforce strict access policies, and avoid unsafe operations.

title: Runtime Performance & Resource Optimization
description: Identify computational bottlenecks, algorithmic hotspots, redundant memory allocations, and expensive I/O operations.

title: Long-Term Maintainability & Clean Code
description: Prevent technical debt accumulation, enforce modular cohesion, and preserve clean self-documenting codebases.

title: Supply Chain Security & Package Hygiene
description: Audit third-party dependencies for known vulnerabilities, verify pinned versions, and avoid malicious packages.

title: Secrets Management & Zero-Leakage Enforcement
description: Detect hardcoded API keys, database credentials, authentication tokens, and private cryptographic keys.

title: Twelve-Factor Configuration & Environment Safety
description: Validate runtime configuration isolation, fail-fast missing environment variables, and strict schema validation.

title: CI/CD Pipelines & Build Determinism
description: Maintain reproducible build configurations, hermetic toolchains, deterministic caching, and workflow integrity.

title: Container Security & Dockerfile Best Practices
description: Enforce rootless container execution, minimal base images, multi-stage builds, and non-sensitive layer caching.

title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Governance
description: Audit Terraform, CloudFormation, and Kubernetes manifests for security baselines and least-privilege configurations.

title: Monorepo Workspace & Package Isolation
description: Ensure strict workspace boundary isolation, shared tooling alignment, and deterministic dependency resolution.

title: Pull Request Governance & Review Hygiene
description: Enforce atomic scoped PRs, informative change descriptions, linked issue references, and clean commit hygiene.

title: Testing Rigor & Coverage Integrity
description: Promote meaningful unit and integration test assertions, deterministic test execution, and edge case coverage.

title: Database Schema Migrations & Zero-Downtime Safety
description: Enforce non-locking DDL operations, reversible migrations, zero-downtime rolling updates, and schema backward-compatibility.

title: Documentation & Architectural Decision Records
description: Keep architecture decision records (ADRs), internal design documents, and README specifications up to date.

title: Repository Context & Tooling Configuration
description: Standardize linters, editor configurations, formatters, and workspace settings files across repositories.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Agent Boundaries
description: Ensure safe, auditable tool definitions, bounded permissions, and verified sandboxing for AI agent MCP integrations.

title: Data Privacy, Redaction & PII Governance
description: Prevent unauthorized capture, storage, or transmission of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and personal records.

title: Accessibility & Universal UX Standards
description: Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, accessible DOM semantics, screen-reader landmarks, and keyboard navigation.

title: Localization, Internationalization & Unicode Safety
description: Enforce localized string abstractions, timezone-aware date handling, and locale-agnostic numerical formatting.

title: Database Query Optimization & Indexing
description: Eliminate N+1 queries, unindexed table scans, inefficient table joins, and unbounded result set queries.

title: Fault Tolerance, Retries & Distributed Idempotency
description: Incorporate exponential backoff, circuit breaking, distributed transaction deduplication, and dead-letter queues.

title: Concurrency, Goroutines & Thread Safety
description: Eliminate data races, deadlock hazards, unbuffered channel leaks, and unprotected shared memory access.

title: Distributed Caching & Invalidation Patterns
description: Ensure proper TTL policies, cache invalidation protocols, prevent stampedes, and avoid stale data hazards.

title: API Contract Versioning & Schema Evolution
description: Maintain strict API versioning, avoid breaking payload modifications, and provide smooth migration paths.

title: LGPD Data Protection Framework
description: Ensure consent management, user data deletion mechanisms, and compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law.

title: GDPR Regulatory Requirements & Data Subject Rights
description: Enforce right-to-erasure workflows, data processing record-keeping, and cross-border transfer compliance under GDPR.

title: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria & Audit Controls
description: Enforce immutable audit trails, strict access controls, tenant isolation, and cryptographic protections for SOC 2.

title: PCI DSS Cardholder Data Security Standards
description: Prohibit plaintext storage of PANs and CVVs, enforce TLS 1.3 in-transit, and maintain strict payment boundary isolation.

title: HIPAA Health Data & Security Safeguards
description: Protect Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) with end-to-end encryption, strict RBAC, and audit logging.

title: React Architecture & Hook Correctness
description: Ensure correct hook dependencies, prevent unnecessary re-renders, and maintain idiomatic component composition.

title: Next.js App Router & Server Component Security
description: Enforce Server Component boundary safety, secure server actions, optimized caching, and route handler validation.

title: Vue.js Composition API & Reactivity Best Practices
description: Enforce proper ref/reactive reactivity, cleanup of lifecycle hooks, and safe template interpolation.

title: Node.js Event Loop & Memory Safety
description: Prevent event loop starvation, unhandled promise rejections, buffer over-allocations, and process crashes.

title: PHP Modern Idioms & Type Safety
description: Mandate strict types, modern constructor property promotion, parameterized PDO queries, and safe superglobal handling.

title: Python Idioms, Typing & Async Safety
description: Enforce PEP 8 style, type annotations, context manager resource cleanup, and safe asyncio coroutine handling.

title: Flutter & Dart State Management
description: Ensure efficient widget rebuild trees, clean BLoC/Provider state architecture, and proper controller disposal.

title: Web Asset Optimization & Content Delivery
description: Optimize modern image formats (AVIF/WebP), compress SVG vectors, and configure immutable cache headers.

title: API Documentation & Docstring Precision
description: Mandate comprehensive docstrings for exported APIs, describing invariants, parameters, return values, and failure modes.
